title: Carpet MITE
description: Modify the world's tick rate and add fake players.
body:
# Carpet MITE

A powerful MITE utility mod that provides advanced features such as world tick rate manipulation and fake player management.

## ✨ Features

### ⏱️ Tick Rate & Dummy Player Control
*   **Time Manipulation:** Modify the world's tick rate (TPS) to speed up or slow down time.
*   **Client-Server Sync:** Advanced options to synchronize or desynchronize client and server speeds for unique effects.
*   **Dummy Players:** Spawn, manage, and remove dummy players for testing or other purposes.

## ⚙️ Advanced Usage: Tick Control

This mod allows you to control the flow of time in the game. Here is how to use the speed manipulation features:

**A Usage Scenario:**
*   First, enter `/tick clientrate sync on` to synchronize the client and server speeds.
*   Then, enter `/tick rate 40` to set both the client and server speeds to 2x (60 for 3x, 1 for 0.05x).
*   To restore the normal speed, enter `/tick rate 20`.
*   **Note:** If you skip `/tick clientrate sync on` and directly enter `/tick rate 40`, only the server speed will double while the player's speed remains unchanged.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2988d0154a11e1258b5c3dbe4197fc94f7b254f.png)
## 📜 Command Reference

### Tick Commands
| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/tick health [ticks]` | Returns the average time the game spends on various tasks. |
| `/tick freeze` | Stops processing of entities, world time, block updates, and redstone. |
| `/tick step [ticks]` | Advances the world by a given number of game ticks while the game is frozen. |
| `/tick rate [tps]` | Changes the TPS (ticks per second). |
| `/tick clientrate [multiplier]` | Changes the client speed. |
| `/tick clientrate sync (on/off)` | Toggles client speed synchronization, off by default. |
| `/tick warp [ticks] [cmd]` | Runs the game as fast as possible for a set amount of time. |

### Fake Player Commands
| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/player spawn [playername]` | Spawns a dummy player. |
| `/player kill [playername]` | Kills a dummy player. |
| `/player remove [playername]` | Removes the dummy player. |
| `/player list` | Lists all dummy players. |
| `/player invincible [playername] (on/off)` | Enable/Disable invincibility for Fake players. |

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zlPqRA6I/images/523029dd5b56cd3830ac99ba0e5377c22cbe7e1f.png)

## 💾 Configuration
You can also enable 'Show Tick HUD', adjust the TPS step, and configure hotkeys in the mod's configuration screen.
